summary: Bug-fix retest for 'Non riesco a loggarmi'. Backend now returns a JWT `token` in login/register response bodies AND sets the httpOnly cookie; frontend stores it in localStorage and sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Verified end-to-end. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests pass (including 4 new tests for token+cookie dual auth, Bearer-only access, invalid Bearer). Frontend UI: 11/12 checks pass — admin login lands on /app, dashboard renders, session persists across reload (via localStorage token), register flow lands on /app, /app is protected after logout. Minor UX issue: logout lands on /accedi instead of the landing page (Protected redirect fires before navigate('/')).

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking logout-btn user ends up on /accedi instead of the landing page /. Because setUser(false) triggers <Protected> re-render before navigate('/') runs, Protected redirects to /accedi. Token clearing and route protection still work correctly (token removed, /app inaccessible), but review spec expected landing.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: In DashboardLayout.doLogout, call navigate('/', {replace:true}) BEFORE (or without) triggering setUser(false), or wrap logout so navigation happens before context state change, so users land on landing page instead of /accedi after logout. Functionally auth is fine — this is a UX polish.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py load_dotenv runs at import (line 4) which is correct.
seed_admin (startup) is idempotent and updates password if ADMIN_PASSWORD changed — good.
get_current_user correctly accepts httpOnly cookie OR Authorization: Bearer fallback — the fix works.
bcrypt hash format verified via startup path; login/register both use bcrypt.hashpw with gensalt (produces $2b$).
CORS: allow_credentials=True with explicit origin (FRONTEND_URL) — correct for httpOnly cookie flow.

set_auth_cookie uses SameSite=None + Secure — required for the cross-site preview URL. Cookie IS set (verified in tests). The Bearer fallback is the safety net for browsers that block third-party SameSite=None cookies.
NOTE: startup() will crash on hot reload if the DB user has multiple accounts sharing an email pre-existing without unique index — but create_index runs first, so OK.
Minor: DashboardLayout logout order (setUser then navigate) causes Protected to redirect to /accedi before the /-navigation lands. Not a security bug, purely UX.
There is no brute-force lockout after N failures — playbook mentions this. Not required by the review request, but worth noting for future hardening.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (11/12 - single minor UX quirk on logout redirect)

test_credentials: Admin: admin@frutteto.it / Frutteto2026! — works. Registration with fresh email works.
seed_data_creation: No permanent seed; each test creates TEST_ prefixed users. UI test created TEST_ui_<uuid>@frutteto.it users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login bug 'Non riesco a loggarmi' is FIXED. Backend returns JWT token in login/register body; frontend persists it in localStorage under key 'pomario_token' and sets axios default Authorization header. Verified session persists across reload even without cookies. The initial /auth/me 401 on cold load (before login) is expected. Only outstanding item is a UX quirk: logout goes to /accedi rather than /.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Cross-site preview environment (agri-track-pro-3.preview.emergentagent.com) served via a proxy — some browsers block the httpOnly SameSite=None cookie, causing /auth/me to 401 and Protected to bounce the user back to /accedi. The app previously relied on that cookie only.
rca_of_the_issue.fix: Backend login/register now also emit `token` field in the response body. Frontend stores it in localStorage (pomario_token) and sets axios `Authorization: Bearer <token>` for all subsequent requests. get_current_user reads Bearer header when no cookie is present.
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Backend pytest test_me_via_bearer_only_no_cookie confirms /auth/me works with Bearer only. Frontend Playwright test confirmed reload keeps user on /app with token in localStorage. Cookie AND token are both set, so the app now works whether the browser accepts the cookie or not.
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: No further action needed for the primary bug. Consider polishing logout navigation order to land on / instead of /accedi.
